data.sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.

data.thesis_note_en: Use connectors, approval cards, weights and creative formats according to their documented access, preserving invitation, account and market limits.

items.title: Kling Image 4.0加入多圖集及長版素材生成
items.title_en: Kling Image 4.0 adds image sets and long-form visuals
items.summary: Kling AI推出Image 4.0，在Creative Studio及API提供圖像生成，支援同一提示製作圖集與長版素材。
items.summary_en: Kling AI introduced Image 4.0 in Creative Studio and the API, including coordinated sets and long-form image generation.
highlights: 單次提示可生成最多10張圖，並按同一創意方向安排各圖重點。
平台可直接修改生成圖內的文字及字體，適合逐步修訂版面。
highlights_en: One prompt can generate up to10 images organized around a creative direction.
Users can edit text and fonts within platform-generated images.
items.why: 商品展示可由逐張製作改為先規劃整組素材，創意團隊可決定哪些畫面共用主題，哪些需要獨立突出產品細節。
items.why_en: Creative teams can plan a complete product set, deciding which frames share a theme and which emphasize separate details.
items.next_step: 以同一產品建立一組主視覺、功能圖及情境圖，逐張核對包裝、文字和色彩，再決定哪些圖需要重做。
items.next_step_en: Create hero, feature and lifestyle images for one product and review packaging, copy and color in each.
items.detail: 官方11月18日文章亦列出原生8K輸出及長版商品頁圖像。這些是模型規格與功能描述，實際可讀性及產品細節仍需逐張覆查。團隊可先把每張圖的用途和必須保留的資訊列清楚，再比較圖集是否沿用一致的產品外觀與視覺方向，最後才安排不同版位的輸出。公告列明支援繁簡中文等七種語言。
items.detail_en: The November 18 official article also lists native 8K and long product-page visuals. These are product specifications rather than verified output quality. Define every frame's purpose and required information, then compare product appearance and art direction before preparing placement variants. The company lists seven languages, including Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

items.title: AWS Quick接入Meta廣告，把活動與商業資料放進同一流程
items.title_en: AWS Quick connects Meta ads with business data
items.summary: AWS宣布Quick加入Meta ads AI連接器，讓團隊以自然語言建立、管理及分析廣告活動。
items.summary_en: AWS added a Meta ads AI connector to Quick for natural-language campaign creation, management and analysis.
highlights: 廣告資料可與第一方及第三方資料組合成儀表板、文件及簡報。
連接時需選擇Quick可存取的專頁、企業及Instagram帳戶。
highlights_en: Meta ads data can be combined with first- and third-party sources in dashboards, documents and slides.
Connection setup selects the Pages, Businesses and Instagram accounts Quick may access.
items.why: 媒體團隊可把廣告表現與庫存、毛利等商業資料並列，決定哪些商品需要調整預算，再準備供人員審閱的變更。
items.why_en: Media teams can compare performance with stock and margin before proposing budget shifts for review.
items.next_step: 先以一組商品活動與獲授權庫存表建立比較，要求只提出預算建議，再核對活動、商品及金額後決定是否修改。
items.next_step_en: Compare one product campaign with authorized inventory data, request proposals only, then reconcile products, campaigns and amounts.
items.detail: AWS的示例包含分析表現、整理商品目錄及準備活動計劃，部分動作要求先批准。MCP是讓AI助理連接外部工具的協定，實際可做哪些操作仍取決於帳戶授權。團隊可先限定一個商品系列，追查分析資料如何連到活動設定，確保建議使用的商品及商業指標有清楚對應。
items.detail_en: AWS illustrates performance analysis, catalog work and campaign planning, with approval in selected workflows. MCP connects AI assistants with external tools; actions depend on account authorization. Trace one product line from business data to campaign settings before applying changes.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 更進新聞：Bing AI Overviews廣告沿用現有活動
items.title_en: Update: Bing AI Overview ads use existing campaigns
items.summary: Microsoft宣布Bing AI Overviews可在答案旁顯示相關廣告，讓既有活動進入新的AI搜尋版位。
items.summary_en: Microsoft announced ads beside Bing AI Overview answers, extending existing campaigns into an AI search placement.
highlights: 毋須另建獨立活動，支援現有活動包括Performance Max及AI Max。
原文列明在中國以外市場提供，並非保證每次查詢都有廣告。
highlights_en: No separate campaign setup is required; existing routes include Performance Max and AI Max.
The stated scope covers markets outside China, without guaranteeing an ad on every query.
items.why: 搜尋需求可在AI整理的答案旁銜接商業訊息，媒體團隊可重新檢視現有素材是否能回應較完整的情境。
items.why_en: Media teams can assess whether existing creative addresses the fuller situations described in AI answers.
items.next_step: 選一組旅遊住宿查詢，把AI答案可能涵蓋的行程需求與現有酒店廣告逐項對照，再確認可取得的投放報表。
items.next_step_en: Compare a travel-itinerary context with current hotel ads and confirm the reporting available for delivery.
items.detail: Microsoft以國家公園行程旁出現酒店廣告說明機制，廣告仍由既有活動承接。團隊可先列出產品在同一情境中的不同需求，核對素材和落地頁是否提供相應資訊，再向平台確認能觀察哪些版位及表現資料。這是廣告庫存與呈現方式的改變，不能由公告推定新增版位已改善銷售。
items.detail_en: Microsoft illustrates hotel ads beside a national-park itinerary. Map the different needs in one product context to creative and destination information, then confirm observable placement data with the platform. An inventory change does not establish improved sales.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.followup: 11月21日版報道AI素材聲明；同一11月19日公告亦涵蓋Bing答案廣告。本篇補充較早的版位消息，早於前述期數。
items.followup_en: Our November 21 issue covered AI creative declarations. The same November 19 announcement also covered Bing answer ads; this adds earlier placement information published before that issue.

items.title: HighLevel Ad Manager加入ChatGPT廣告建案與報表
items.title_en: HighLevel adds ChatGPT campaign building and reporting
items.summary: HighLevel讓廣告主在Ad Manager連接OpenAI Ads帳戶，建立及衡量ChatGPT廣告活動。
items.summary_en: HighLevel lets advertisers connect an OpenAI Ads account to build and measure ChatGPT campaigns in Ad Manager.
highlights: 廣告組可加入描述適用對話的情境提示，素材使用標題、描述及方形圖片。
帳單及廣告審核仍由OpenAI處理；推出時使用Standard活動類型。
highlights_en: Ad groups use context hints, while creative combines a title, description and square image.
OpenAI retains billing and ad review; launch campaigns use the Standard type.
items.why: 代理商可把ChatGPT活動與既有渠道放在同一管理介面，決定哪些情境提示、素材及轉換事件需獨立準備。
items.why_en: Agencies can decide which context hints, assets and conversion events need separate preparation within the shared management interface.
items.next_step: 用一項明確的產品查詢情境草擬廣告，對照情境提示、方形素材、落地頁及轉換事件，再進入平台審閱流程。
items.next_step_en: Draft one product-query context and reconcile hints, square creative, destination and conversion events before review.
items.detail: 這是HighLevel的渠道整合，並非ChatGPT廣告首次推出。官方文件列出觸及、點擊及轉換三種目標，並提供裝置與位置等報表分段。自訂受眾需要至少25,000名匹配使用者，活動範本仍屬後續計劃。團隊可先由帳戶已有資格及實際支援的市場開始確認投放安排。
items.detail_en: This is a HighLevel channel integration, not the original ChatGPT Ads launch. Objectives cover reach, clicks and conversions, with device and location reporting. Custom audiences need25,000 matched users and templates remain planned. Confirm account eligibility and supported markets first.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: AdMaven邀請制推出Mave，廣告變更須批准確認卡
items.title_en: AdMaven rolls out invite-only Mave with approval cards
items.summary: AdMaven在廣告主儀表板加入Mave，以對話處理pop廣告建案、帳戶分析及設定調整。
items.summary_en: AdMaven added Mave to its advertiser dashboard for conversational pop-campaign creation, account analysis and settings changes.
highlights: 變動須由廣告主批准確認卡，卡片10分鐘後失效。
服務按帳戶邀請開放；API問答屬唯讀，不能據此修改活動。
highlights_en: Changes require an advertiser's confirmation card, which expires after10 minutes.
Access rolls out by invitation per account; API Q&A is read-only.
items.why: 媒體操作可從分析直接形成待批准變更，團隊可決定哪些批次暫停或預算調整適合用確認卡覆查。
items.why_en: Media teams can assess which batch pauses or budget adjustments suit a reviewed confirmation card.
items.next_step: 取得邀請後，先以少量活動提出暫停建議，逐項對照活動名稱及擬改狀態，在確認卡有效期內決定是否執行。
items.next_step_en: After receiving access, propose pauses for a small group and reconcile campaign names and states before the card expires.
items.detail: 官方表示可一次建立最多5個pop活動，或批次暫停、恢復最多20個活動。Pop是彈出式廣告格式，仍須經標準素材審核。Mave亦可按國家、裝置及流量來源拆解資料。團隊可先把唯讀查詢與實際寫入分開，確認卡片顯示的對象和設定完整，再擴大批次操作範圍。
items.detail_en: The company lists creation of up to 5 pop campaigns and batch pause/resume for up to 20. Pop ads are pop-up formats and still undergo normal creative review. Keep read-only analysis separate from writes, and inspect the objects and settings on each card before scaling batch work.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Spaceback把社群素材轉成互動展示廣告
items.title_en: Spaceback turns social assets into interactive display ads
items.summary: Spaceback正式推出Interactive Display Units，讓品牌由既有社群內容製作測驗、投票及遊戲等展示廣告。
items.summary_en: Spaceback made Interactive Display Units generally available for adapting social content into quizzes, polls and games.
highlights: 平台按品牌貼文、色彩及標誌建立選項，再由廣告主挑選。
素材以標準展示尺寸交付，可經DSP或Spaceback Deal ID投放。
highlights_en: The platform builds options from brand posts, colors and logos for advertiser selection.
Standard-size assets run through DSPs or a Spaceback Deal ID.
items.why: 社群內容可延伸至可互動的展示版位，創意營運團隊可決定哪些貼文適合改成測驗、揭示或遊戲流程。
items.why_en: Creative operations can choose which social posts fit a quiz, reveal or playable display sequence.
items.next_step: 選一則有明確產品訊息的貼文，分別設計投票與揭示流程，核對互動完成後的訊息及落地頁是否一致。
items.next_step_en: Turn one clear product post into poll and reveal concepts, checking the end message and destination.
items.detail: DSP是讓買方採購程式化廣告的平台，Deal ID則用於辨識交易安排。新格式涵蓋測驗、投票、刮開揭示及遊戲等類型，品牌可按原素材選擇互動機制。團隊可先檢查訊息在不同尺寸及操作步驟中的呈現，再比較要保留哪些社群元素，安排小範圍的素材測試及媒體交付。
items.detail_en: A DSP supports programmatic buying, while a Deal ID identifies a trading arrangement. Formats include quizzes, polls, scratch-to-reveal units and games. Inspect message presentation across sizes and interaction steps before choosing which social elements to retain for limited testing and delivery.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: HeyGen Avatar 6按稿件語境生成動作，既有分身可升級
items.title_en: HeyGen Avatar 6 follows script context, with existing-avatar upgrades
items.summary: HeyGen推出Avatar 6，以語音及稿件內容引導分身的動作與表情，支援原生2K影片。
items.summary_en: HeyGen launched Avatar 6 with audio- and script-led movement and expressions, including native 2K video.
highlights: 既有Personal Avatars可升級，毋須重新錄製素材。
真人逼真影片保留在HeyGen平台，需明確同意及身份核實。
highlights_en: Existing Personal Avatars can upgrade without new recording.
Realistic real-person videos remain on HeyGen with identity verification and explicit consent.
items.why: 講者影片可把動作設計與稿件內容一起審閱，內容團隊可決定哪些語句需要更清楚的手勢或情緒提示。
items.why_en: Content teams can review gestures alongside scripts and choose which lines need clearer motion or emotion cues.
items.next_step: 以一段產品示範稿標記指向、數量及語氣要求，比較分身動作是否對應句意，再修訂不合適的段落。
items.next_step_en: Mark pointing, counting and tone requirements in one product script and compare movement with each line's meaning.
items.detail: 公司表示模型可參照個人素材的動作方式，並依說話語境調整表演。第三方平台的支援仍有範圍區分，不能把照片或虛擬分身接入等同所有真人影片都可外部生成。團隊可先以已取得同意的講者材料建立參考，逐段審閱口形、動作與產品陳述，再由品牌負責人決定哪些版本適合交付。
items.detail_en: HeyGen describes reference-led personal motion and contextual performance. Third-party access has scope limits: photo or virtual avatars do not imply every real-person workflow is available externally. Use consented reference material and review lip sync, motion and product statements before the brand owner approves delivery.

items.title: 更進新聞：ChatGPT Space向Plus推出，分享仍需帳戶資格
items.title_en: Update: ChatGPT Space rolls out to Plus with restricted sharing
items.summary: OpenAI開始向全球18歲以上Plus使用者推出Space，將互動頁面與簡報協作擴至更多帳戶。
items.summary_en: OpenAI began a global Space rollout to Plus users aged 18 and older, widening access to interactive pages and presentation collaboration.
highlights: 收件人需有瀏覽權限，並登入具Space資格的付費帳戶。
Free使用者不能開啟分享頁面，現階段沒有公開連結。
highlights_en: Recipients need viewing permission and a paid account with Space access.
Free users cannot open shared pages, and public links are unavailable.
items.why: 代理商可重新評估哪些客戶能在Space共同修改簡報，並按收件人的帳戶資格決定交付形式。
items.why_en: Agencies can assess which clients can collaborate in Space and choose delivery formats around recipient access.
items.next_step: 在一份客戶簡報開始協作前，先確認雙方帳戶已有Space及頁面權限，再測試收件人能否開啟該頁。
items.next_step_en: Confirm both accounts have Space and page permission, then test whether the recipient can open a shared client brief.
items.detail: Space可建立互動頁面及簡報，也可按已連接工具的資料安排內容更新。這次的新進展是Plus資格擴展，並非首次推出整套功能。側欄的Space會取代Library作為檔案與頁面的入口；團隊可先選一份需要共同修改的材料，確認參與者資格後再安排後續更新。
items.detail_en: Space supports interactive pages, slides and updates from connected tools. The incremental event is Plus access rather than the first launch of all features. Space replaces Library as the file and page entry point. Start with one collaborative brief after confirming participants' eligibility.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.followup: 9月30日版已報道Pages及Space投入使用；11月20日更新擴展Plus接入資格，原有分享限制仍需核對。
items.followup_en: Our September 30 issue covered Pages and Space in production. The November 20 update expands Plus access, with sharing limits still applying.

items.title: 更進新聞：騰訊發布Hy4權重，提供三種模型版本
items.title_en: Update: Tencent publishes Hy4 weights in three variants
items.summary: 騰訊已發布Hy4完整模型權重，提供指令版、FP8版及預訓練base版，讓團隊評估自行部署。
items.summary_en: Tencent published full Hy4 weights as instruction-tuned, FP8 and pretrained-base variants for deployment evaluation.
highlights: 模型卡列出文字、圖像及影片理解，以及約100萬token上下文。
採用Tencent Hy License，商業使用安排須按該授權條款核對。
highlights_en: The card lists text, image and video understanding with roughly one million context tokens.
Weights use the Tencent Hy License; commercial arrangements follow its terms.
items.why: 權重接入讓技術團隊多一種部署選擇，行銷資料應用可評估哪些跨檔分析值得在自有環境測試，再決定是否投入運算資源。
items.why_en: Technical teams can assess which campaign-document tasks merit testing in their own environment before committing compute resources.
items.next_step: 先以一份已有標準答案的活動文件包列出文字、圖片及表格任務，請技術團隊評估容量、部署版本及授權條件。
items.next_step_en: Define text, image and table tasks in a campaign document set with known answers, then assess capacity, variant and license requirements.
items.detail: 11月5日版報道時權重仍屬計劃，這次可核對的進展是模型檔案與官方部署資料已公開。Base版是預訓練模型，不能直接當作已調整好的聊天版本。團隊可先用指令版安排有限測試，分開估算運算、維護及資料處理要求，再比較自行部署與既有託管服務的適用工作。
items.detail_en: Our November 5 issue described weights as planned. Checkpoint links and official deployment information are now public. The base checkpoint is pretrained rather than a chat-tuned version. Evaluate compute, maintenance and data-handling needs separately when comparing an instruction model with hosted access.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.followup: 11月5日版報道Hy4託管推出及權重計劃；11月20日官方程式庫提供模型權重與部署資料。
items.followup_en: Our November 5 issue covered hosted Hy4 and planned weights. The November 20 official repository supplies checkpoint links and deployment material.

items.title: Lumo Desktop加入連接器、排程與可重用工作指引
items.title_en: Lumo Desktop adds connectors, schedules and reusable instructions
items.summary: Proton推出Windows、macOS及Linux版Lumo Desktop，讓助理連接檔案與工具，並加入排程及技能。
items.summary_en: Proton launched Lumo Desktop on Windows, macOS and Linux with app connections, schedules and Skills.
highlights: 動作可設為自動、需批准或封鎖；已連接工具預設在對話啟用。
排程有獨立權限，技能可保存寫作指引、範本及參考檔案。
highlights_en: Actions can be automatic, approval-based or blocked; connected tools are enabled in conversations by default.
Schedules have their own permissions, while Skills retain instructions, templates and reference files.
items.why: 內容營運可把資料來源、執行時間與寫作規則組成固定流程，團隊可決定哪些步驟自動整理，哪些交予人員批准。
items.why_en: Content operations can define which steps of a recurring source-to-draft process run automatically and which require approval.
items.next_step: 先建立一份定期內容資料摘要，限定可讀取的資料夾，加入品牌寫作範本，並把任何對外動作設為需批准。
items.next_step_en: Limit a recurring content digest to a specific folder, add a brand template and require approval for external actions.
items.detail: 連接器可存取本機工具、Proton Mail Bridge及支援的第三方服務，也可接自設MCP伺服器。技能會按對話需要套用，既有Custom Lumos將遷移成技能。團隊可先分開檢查來源存取和執行動作，再為一項固定摘要安排排程，確認每次產出的來源與格式符合工作要求。
items.detail_en: Connectors support local tools, Proton Mail Bridge, selected third-party services and custom MCP servers. Relevant Skills apply in conversation, and Custom Lumos migrate to Skills. Review source access separately from actions, then inspect each digest's sources and format.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

evidence.audit_status: Ten original announcements read and separately reopened by same assistant. Semantic relevance PASS and event-workflow-decision substitution tests recorded. Preserved invite-only Mave, Plus sharing eligibility, account/billing boundaries, Bing market exclusion, dated earlier coverage and custom model license. Removed outcome/realism/efficiency figures. No independent human approval or product trial claimed.

review_provenance.first_pass: Original company text, official product documentation and dated direct reporting inspected, not headlines alone.
review_provenance.second_pass: Same assistant separately re-retrieved source text to challenge dates, release stages, scope, attribution and unsupported outcomes; individual references retained.

stories.title_zh: Kling Image 4.0加入多圖集及長版素材生成

source_documents.evidence_locator: Official blog L42–50 / Official blog L58,L110–121 / Official blog L98–107
